reviews.body:
## Code Review

This pull request implements a fallback to memory-based storage (NonPersistentStorage) when writing to browser storage fails due to a QuotaExceededError (e.g., when storage is full). It includes corresponding unit tests and a changeset. The review feedback recommends replacing the deprecated __proto__ property in the tests with window.Storage.prototype to ensure standard compatibility.

Avoid using the deprecated `__proto__` property to access the prototype of the storage object. Instead, use `window.Storage.prototype` or `Object.getPrototypeOf()` which are standard and widely supported across all JavaScript environments.
